clubs.name: NITER Computer Club
clubs.about: The NITER Computer Club (NCC) is the home of programmers, developers and tech enthusiasts at NITER. We organize programming contests, coding bootcamps, tech talks, hackathons and workshops on web development, AI and competitive programming to sharpen the technical skills of students.
clubs.weekly: Weekly coding practice — every Saturday, 3:00 PM

clubs.name: NITER Science Society
clubs.about: NITER Science Society promotes scientific thinking and research culture among students. We run science fairs, olympiads, model exhibitions, seminars on emerging science and opportunities for undergraduate research.

clubs.name: NITER Career Club
clubs.tagline: Your bridge from campus to career.
clubs.about: NITER Career Club prepares students for the professional world with CV clinics, mock interviews, industry talks, internship drives and career counseling sessions in partnership with leading companies and alumni.

clubs.name: NITER Language Club
clubs.about: The NITER Language Club organizes spoken English courses, debating sessions, book clubs, creative writing workshops and language exchange programs to build confident communicators.

clubs.name: NITER Cultural Club
clubs.about: The NITER Cultural Club celebrates music, dance, drama, fine arts and the rich cultural heritage of Bangladesh. We stage annual cultural programs, auditions, art exhibitions and seasonal celebrations throughout the year.
clubs.weekly: Cultural practice — every Sunday & Wednesday, 5:00 PM

clubs.name: NITER Games & Sports Club
clubs.about: The NITER Games & Sports Club runs inter-department tournaments in football, cricket, basketball and badminton, plus indoor games like chess and carrom. We select and train teams for inter-university competitions.
clubs.weekly: Evening practice — daily, 5:00–7:00 PM at the field

clubs.name: NITER Islamic Society
clubs.about: The NITER Islamic Society organizes weekly Quran and Hadith study circles, Islamic lectures, and programs for Ramadan and Eid. It provides a supportive environment for spiritual and moral development.
clubs.weekly: Quran & Hadith circle — every Friday after Jumu'ah

clubs.name: NITER Robotics Club
clubs.about: The NITER Robotics Club brings together students passionate about robotics, electronics and automation. Members learn to build and program robots through workshops, and compete in national and international robotics contests.

clubs.name: NITER Film and Photography
clubs.tagline: Frame the moment, direct the story.
clubs.about: NITER Film and Photography brings together photographers, filmmakers and visual storytellers. We run photography walks, exhibitions, short-film productions, editing workshops and campus event coverage — every memorable frame at NITER is captured by our members.

clubs.name: NITER Journalism Society
clubs.about: The NITER Journalism Society trains student journalists in news writing, interviewing, feature reporting and media ethics. Members run the campus news desk, publish the campus magazine, and collaborate with NITER Film and Photography on multimedia stories and event coverage.

clubs.name: NITER Social Welfare Club
clubs.about: The NITER Social Welfare Club organizes blood donation camps, winter clothing drives, tree plantation programs and charity initiatives for underprivileged communities around our campus.

notices.title: Workshop on Modern Web Development
notices.body: Join our hands-on 2-day workshop covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React. Bring your laptop — seats are limited to 60. Certificate will be provided.

notices.title: CodeStorm 2025 — Inter-University Programming Contest
notices.body: Registrations are now open for our annual programming contest. Teams of 2–3 members. Top teams win cash prizes and trophies. Register before the deadline.

notices.title: National Science Olympiad 2025 — Registrations Open
notices.body: Test your knowledge in physics, chemistry, biology and math. Winners advance to the national round. Open to all departments.

notices.title: CV Clinic & Mock Interview Session
notices.body: Get your CV reviewed by HR professionals from leading companies and practice real interview questions. Bring a printed copy of your CV.

notices.title: Spoken English Crash Course — Batch 7
notices.body: An 8-week intensive course to build your confidence in speaking English. Includes daily practice, group discussions and a final presentation. Certificate awarded on completion.

notices.title: Annual Cultural Program 2025 — Audition Notice
notices.body: Auditions for the grand annual cultural program will be held this week. Open to singers, dancers, actors, reciters and instrumentalists. Show us your talent!

notices.title: Inter-Department Football Tournament 2025
notices.body: The biggest football event of the year! Each department forms a team of 11 players. Trophies, medals and prizes for the winners. Register your team now.

notices.title: Weekly Quran & Hadith Study Circle
notices.body: Join us every Friday after Jumu'ah prayer for a relaxed study circle. All students are welcome, regardless of background.

notices.title: Line Follower Robot Workshop — Build Your First Bot
notices.body: In this one-day workshop you will assemble and program your own line-follower robot. All components provided by the club.

notices.title: Photography Walk — Old Dhaka Heritage Tour
notices.body: A guided photo walk through the heritage sites of Old Dhaka. Bring any camera — even your phone works. Great for portfolio shots!

notices.title: Blood Donation Camp — Save a Life
notices.body: Our annual blood donation camp is back. Donate blood and save up to three lives. Refreshments and certificates for all donors.

notices.title: Campus Magazine 2025 — Call for Writers, Reporters & Photographers
notices.body: The NITER Journalism Society is inviting writers, reporters, editors and photographers to contribute to this year's campus magazine and news desk. News reports, features, interviews and photo essays are all welcome — submit your application today.

complaints.title: Workshop seats filled too fast
complaints.body: The web development workshop reached 60 seats within an hour and many students missed out. Please consider adding more batches or a waitlist.
complaints.reply: Thanks for the feedback — we are planning a second batch next month and a waitlist for future events.

complaints.title: Football tournament schedule clashes with classes
complaints.body: Two knock-out matches are scheduled during our lab hours. Could evening slots be added for the remaining rounds?
complaints.reply: Fixed — evening slots have been added for all remaining matches.

complaints.title: WiFi is very slow in the central library
complaints.body: Internet in the central library has been almost unusable for the last two weeks, especially after 3 PM.

complaints.title: Computer lab printer not working (Lab 2)
complaints.body: The printer in Computer Lab 2 has been out of paper / erroring since Monday. Needed for assignments.
complaints.reply: Printer serviced and refilled — should be working now.
